## TM.47 for P1

**B01 — Written at**  
Bangkok Immigration Office

**B02 — Filing date**  
Day 24, month November, year 2569 B.E.

**B03 — Full name**

GIVEN_P1

MIDDLE_P1

SURNAME_P1

After the values are restored, write them together in block capitals on the full-name line, in passport order.

**B04 — Nationality**  
Indian

**B05 — Visa**  
Check **NON-IMM**.

**B06 — Date entered Thailand**  
Day 26, month August, year 2569 B.E.

**B07 — Means of travel**  
Airplane

**B08 — Passport number**

ID_P1

**B09 — Arrival card number**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Enter your arrival card number directly on the form.

**B10 — Lane or road**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Enter the lane or road from your current Thai address.

**B11 — Tambol**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Enter the subdistrict from your current Thai address.

**B12 — Amphur**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Enter the district from your current Thai address.

**B13 — Province**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Enter the province from your current Thai address.

**B14 — Phone**

PHONE_P1

**B15 — Signature**  
NEEDS-YOU  
Sign the form by hand.
